snippets: Home Magic of Santa The Storybook Reservations The Experience Contact About Us About Us A Little Out of the Way.
Magic of Santa® is located in Weston, Texas—the oldest town in Collin County.
We wanted families to come somewhere that feels different—a place where, for a little while, Christmas can slow down and children can simply believe .
For more than a decade, Magic of Santa has welcomed families from across the country and around the world.
Many of our families return year after year, and some travel hundreds of miles to continue a Christmas tradition that has become part of their children's story.
This isn't a stop at the mall or a few hurried minutes in front of a Christmas backdrop.
Magic of Santa is a portrait experience built around the relationship between your child and Santa—and the moments that happen when we give that relationship time to become real.
Chat with Elfis , Santa's Chief Public Relations Elf, right here on the website.
The Artist Behind the Magic Chris Fritchie, M.Photog., M.Artist, Cr.Photog., CPP , created Magic of Santa after a career spanning more than two decades as a professional photographer.
Today, Chris is recognized for his children's fine-art and Santa portraiture and is an award-winning photographic artist, educator, and judge.

His work has been recognized at the international, national, and state levels, and he teaches photographers around the country the craft of creating portraits built around genuine moments rather than simply photographs.
Three words define what we believe a portrait should be.
Santa doesn't spend your session staring at our camera.
And it's why, after more than a decade of Magic of Santa, we're still trying to make every year's work better than the year before.
It's whether the portrait we create for your family still matters generations from now.

— Elfis Pricing & Ordering How much does The Magic of Santa cost?

The Magic of Santa works a little differently from a traditional mini session, so there isn't one "package price." Some of our families have been coming to see us for nearly a decade and spend just a few hundred dollars each year.
Others choose to invest considerably more in custom wall portraits, albums, memory boxes, and other artwork created for their family.
Those prices are à la carte , and families who build their own collection can save 25%.
For our First 30 families , the $300 paid when booking goes entirely toward your artwork order.
And because you're one of our First 30 families, your session is photographed by Chris Fritchie , creator of The Magic of Santa.
Rather than deciding what every family should buy before they've even seen their photographs, we let you build your own collection.

Choose at least one item from three of our four artwork categories (Wall Portraits, Tabletops, Albums, and Memory Boxes) and you'll receive 25% off your entire artwork order when your order is completed during your in-person reveal.
You get the collection that actually fits your family, not a package full of things you didn't want.
Every finished portrait gets the same artistic attention whether it becomes a 40-inch wall portrait or a digital file.
A family investing around $1,000 in artwork may have roughly 6–7 finished images, even if their main purchase is one large wall portrait.
Our portraits are individually color graded and finished for the professional labs and craftsmen we use.
Many consumer labs apply their own automatic corrections, which can dramatically change the color, density, and look of the finished portrait.
You're commissioning the creation of the portrait .
That work has been recognized at the highest levels of professional photography, including Chris Fritchie being named 2024 MPI International Portrait Artist of the Year .
If we ever have to reschedule because of weather or illness on our side, we'll work with you to find the next date that fits your family.
Because every session is reserved just for your family, reservation payments are non-refundable .

meta: Meet TinTin Wynn, a Dallas wedding photographer and filmmaker creating timeless, true-to-life images with relaxed direction and loose editorial storytelling.
snippets: Dallas Wedding Photographer This is the "why" behind the how.
In a world where many photographers discover their passion early in life, TinTin Wynn's path to professional photography began with an unused Christmas present.
AWARDS But success hasn't changed the foundation of family and faith that grounds both his life and work.
Together with his wife Cherielyn, Wynn heads a vibrant blended family of six children ranging from 4 to 23 years old.
The family is deeply involved in their local church, where Wynn serves on the photography team and particularly enjoys documenting the annual FUSE Ministries Camps.
In early 2021, Wynn began offering free family photo sessions, gradually building his portfolio with mini-sessions advertised on Facebook.
The real turning point came in March 2021, when two fellow church members asked him to photograph their weddings.

"I said 'YES!' without hesitation," Wynn remembers, "then spent the next two months learning everything I could about wedding photography." Those first weddings proved to be the catalyst for what would become a thriving business.

Now in his fourth year as a professional photographer, Wynn's dedication to his craft has earned him recognition as one of the three best wedding photographers in Frisco, Texas, by Three Best Rated—an unsolicited honor that came just two an
The Journey of TinTin Wynn Wynn dreams of opening his own studio and possibly making photography a family affair.

It's a fitting aspiration for someone whose own journey into photography began with family and has grown into something far beyond what he could have imagined when he first picked up his wife's unused camera.
Visual Storytelling Anyone with a camera can document a wedding.
It's about understanding that every wedding has its own heartbeat, its own personality that deserves to be honored through intentional artistry.
Twenty years from now, I want you to look at these images and see your wedding day — not a filter that was popular the year you got married.
Every Wedding Deserves Its Own Story No two couples are the same.
Different personalities, different families, different dreams.
The storyteller's job is to listen—not just with ears, but with eyes and heart—and then translate what makes this wedding uniquely theirs into images that will matter for generations.

The best wedding photography happens when I disappear into the background and let their authentic story unfold, then use every tool in my creative arsenal—angle, light, shadow, color, motion—to honor it truthfully and beautifully.
And every single wedding reminds me what a privilege it is to be trusted with that responsibility.

snippets: I decided to focus my photography business on children, high school seniors, and family portraits, knowing that these moments are some of life’s most precious.
I believe every family deserves to have their story beautifully documented, and I strive to bring that vision to life in my work.
I am particularly drawn to natural light; there’s something ethereal about the way it dances across a child’s face or bathes a family in warmth.
Through my photography, I aim to create images that not only capture faces but also reflect the personalities and connections within each family.
Whether it’s a playful portrait of a child, a milestone moment for a high school senior, or a heartfelt family gathering, I pour my heart into every session.
As I embark on this journey, I am excited to connect with families and individuals who share my passion for preserving memories.

snippets: About — Gittings Houston 0 Skip to Content Open Menu Close Menu Open Menu Close Menu PORTRAITURE REIMAGINED At Gittings Houston , we’re honored to carry forward one of the most storied legacies in American portrait photography.
Specifically, their craftsmanship, storytelling, and deep respect for what portraiture can mean to a family, especially children.
They’re not just stepping into a new studio—they’re becoming stewards of a brand that has shaped the very foundation of fine portraiture in America.
By 1928, driven by talent and determination, he moved to Texas and opened portrait studios in Houston and Dallas Houston under his own name, Gittings Studio .

From those early days, Paul Gittings’ philosophy was clear: “ Portrait Photography is a tool for recording the story we try to tell posterity – a story not of features alone, but of the human force behind those features.
This guiding belief led Gittings to become known for an unmatched attention to detail and a level of quality that set the gold standard in portrait photography.
Over the years, the studio has gained national acclaim for its bold, emotional portraiture and contemporary style rooted in timeless craftsmanship.
As co-Founders of Sigmon Taylor Photography, they’ve earned national recognition for their ability to create bold, emotionally rich portraits rooted in fine art.

They’re both award-winning photographic artists and ASP Fellowship Degree recipients repeatedly recognized by Professional Photographer Magazine, experienced educators, and respected voices in the portrait community.
Michael's early work photographing families across the South was infused with Gittings’ influence before he ever met the man behind the name.
Their goal is to protect the integrity and timeless elegance that has defined Gittings since 1928, while also introducing exciting new offerings like our Black Label and Gilded portrait experiences.

Bridal boudoir shoots are an amazing opportunity to take the look and feel from your wedding day and carry them through in an album that will help commemorate you at your sexiest.

What are Photographic Painted Portraits?
Humans have been creating portraits of each other for centuries.
Photographic portraits have been an option in more recent human history, but the recent trend of creating painted portraits from photographs has combined the two artforms.
A painted portrait from Natalie Roberson Photography will provide you with a beautiful piece of art to hang on the walls of your home.

When you commission a painted portrait from Natalie Roberson Photography, you get the best of both worlds – a professionally posed photograph transformed into a unique work of art to be treasured for a lifetime!

Consultation : During your initial meeting with Natalie Roberson Photography, we will discuss your ideas and vision for the painted portrait.

snippets: Professional Headshots & Team Photography — The Woodlands
Plouvier Art creates polished headshots for professionals and teams — with a guided process that keeps the experience efficient, calm, and professional.
Whether you're updating one executive portrait or photographing an entire staff, the goal is the same: images that feel cohesive, confident, and aligned with your brand.
A strong portrait does more than show what someone looks like — it shows who they are and the world they work in.
Whether it's a single headshot or your entire team, the right light, setting, and timing make people read as competent, trustworthy, and prepared.
And when it's a team, every portrait should look like it belongs to the same company, held to the same standard.
Investment Headshot and team collections are tailored to the number of people, location, setup, and image needs.
Corporate portrait days and team sessions are available by custom quote.
Questions Professional headshots in The Woodlands Do you photograph individual professionals as well as corporate teams?
Sessions are built for individual executives, founders, and professionals, and for full teams — from a single portrait to an entire staff.
How much do professional headshots cost in The Woodlands?
Headshot and team collections are tailored to the number of people, the location, the setup, and how the images will be used, so there is no single list price.
Individual sessions and corporate portrait days are quoted after a short consultation, where we talk through team size, scheduling, and what the images need to do.
On-location corporate headshots are available throughout The Woodlands, Montgomery County, and Greater Houston.
Do you work in different headshot styles?
Read more on the four styles and the research behind them → What should I wear for a professional headshot?
Every session is fully directed — posture, expression, angle, and the small adjustments that change how confident and approachable a portrait reads.
It is a polished portrait that still looks like you.
Are professional headshots retouched?
Can you keep our team headshots consistent as the company grows?
For teams that cannot all be in one room on one day, composite group portraits are available: each person photographed individually against the same setup, then combined into a single cohesive image.
What is the difference between a professional headshot and a personal branding session?
A headshot presents you clearly and confidently in a single frame, for LinkedIn, a company site, a directory, or a press page.

A personal branding session builds a library instead: multiple looks, environmental portraits, working images, details, and both horizontal and vertical compositions made for your website, marketing, and PR.
If you need a collection rather than one portrait, that is the branding session.

Kellie Gann & Company CONTACT KELLIE SIGN IN MENU Lufkin, TX FINE ART PORTRAIT PHOTOGRAPHY Welcome to Kellie Gann & Company, where we turn every portrait into a masterpiece.
From weddings to professional headshots to family portraits and artistic editorial shots, we make the experience relaxed, personalized, and uniquely yours.
Your family will look a little different, your children will be a little taller, and the moments that feel so ordinary today will become some of your most treasured memories.
For over 12 years, I've had the incredible privilege of documenting life's most meaningful moments for families throughout Lufkin and East Texas.
From tiny newborn fingers and first birthdays to graduating seniors, wedding days, and generations gathered together — every story is unique, and every season deserves to be remembered.
At Kellie Gann & Company Photography , I believe your portraits should be more than just beautiful pictures.
They should become treasured pieces of your family's history — photographs you'll proudly display in your home, share with loved ones, and pass down for generations.
WHAT WE LOVE TO PHOTOGRAPH: Families & Children — Capturing genuine connections, sweet personalities, and the beautiful chaos of family life.
Maternity & Newborns — Preserving the anticipation of new beginnings and those precious first days that pass far too quickly.
High School Seniors — Creating portraits that celebrate who they are and the exciting futures ahead.
Weddings & Couples — Documenting love stories, meaningful traditions, and once-in-a-lifetime celebrations.
Professional Branding & Headshots — Helping individuals and businesses make a beautiful, confident first impression.
I'll help guide you through the process so you can relax, enjoy the experience, and walk away with portraits that truly reflect the people and relationships you treasure.
YOUR FAMILY'S STORY IS HAPPENING RIGHT NOW.
As I celebrate more than 12 years in business, I want to express my sincere gratitude to every family, couple, and individual who has trusted me with their memories.

meta: SENIOR EXPERIENCE - CPP SENIORS
snippets: SENIOR EXPERIENCE - CPP SENIORS MENU THE SENIOR PORTRAIT EXPERIENCE Senior year is a once-in-a-lifetime milestone, and your portraits should reflect everything that makes this season special.

The CPP Seniors experience is designed to be relaxed, personalized, and fully guided so you and your senior can simply enjoy the process while creating portraits that will be treasured for years to come.

A GUIDED EXPERIENCE DESIGNED TO MAKE SENIOR PORTRAITS UNFORGETTABLE STEP 1 - PLANNING YOUR SESSION Every CPP Seniors session begins with a consultation at the studio where we plan the details of your senior’s portrait experience together.
This is also a great time to look through album and wall portrait samples so you can begin thinking about how you would like to enjoy your portraits once they are finished.
STEP 2 - YOUR PORTRAIT SESSION Your senior session is designed to feel relaxed and fun while creating portraits that feel natural and confident.
Whether your senior prefers something classic, adventurous, or completely unique, the goal is to create portraits that feel authentic to them.
Professional lighting techniques are used to create polished, magazine-style portraits and ensure beautiful, consistent results whether we are photographing in the studio or outdoors.
STEP 3 - VIEWING YOUR PORTRAITS After your session, we’ll meet again at the studio for your ordering appointment where you’ll see your portraits for the first time.
This is often one of the most exciting parts of the experience as families see their senior’s portraits come together.
STEP 4 - CELEBRATING YOUR SENIOR YEAR Many families choose a combination of albums and wall portraits to celebrate this milestone.
Albums beautifully tell the story of senior year, while wall portraits become lasting pieces of artwork displayed in your home.
These finished pieces allow your senior’s portraits to be enjoyed for years long after graduation.
Matching digital files are included with the artwork you select so you can also share your favorite images with friends and family.

HIGH END PORTRAITS Hey Seniors!
At CPP Seniors, I specialize in creating custom senior portrait experiences that are fun, stylish, and completely centered around YOU.
From outdoor adventure sessions to modern studio senior photos, I design every senior portrait session to reflect your personality and style.
My goal is to help you feel confident, comfortable, and absolutely amazing in front of the camera while capturing images you and your family will treasure forever.

As an East Texas senior photographer, work closely with moms to create a custom senior portrait experience that truly reflects who their child is in this once-in-a-lifetime season.
The finished portraits become lasting artwork in your home and a daily reminder of just how special and loved they are.
As your senior prepares for graduation and the next chapter of life, you will have timeless portraits that keep this season close to your heart for years to come.

snippets: THE SANTA EXPERIENCE - Laura A.
Schmidbauer MENU THE SANTA EXPERIENCE BOOK NOW What is the Santa Experience?
This is a personalized private session for your family.
You show up the time of your session, and do not have to wait in line to see Santa for a quick photo printed on site like at a mall.
Santa will know your children's names, and has many different things to do with the kids based upon their age and responses.
They may go over their Christmas letter to Santa.
Santa may read a book to them.
Santa may have the children help him decorate the tree.
Show the children where the North Pole is on the globe, where the kids live, and how far away they are from Santa.
Santa may ask if they have been good and if they think they are on the naughty or nice list.
Santa may even help tuck in the tiniest kids to bed!
Each session is different and personal to each family.
The family session is designed for the immediate family members.
Keep in mind that the more people in the room or with Santa means less individual time for the children with Santa.
If you have a large family you may want to consider booking and paying for 2 session times back to back.
Unfortunately not to the Santa Experience .
I will be having Santa Pet Sessions available later in 2026.
There is not enough time the day of to prepare for a new family session.
There are 3 pre-paid Santa Experience Packages to choose during pre-registration.
You will set up an Image Reveal Appointment within 1-2 days after your Santa Experience.
At that appointment you will choose your favorite images from your Santa Experience.
(The number of proofs depend on which Santa Experience you choose and the interaction of the kids with Santa) I signed up for the Deluxe Session but I think I want the Basic Session now.
What if there is a family emergency or my kid is sick the day of the event?

While there are no refunds for this event, if you have a honest family emergency (not I don't feel like going today or my child is throwing a fit, etc.) You can apply the payment as a credit to a future family session with me if I am availa
Keep in mind though that session won't involve Santa and my schedule is very limited for sessions through the end of the year.
What should my children and/or family wear?
Also if you are looking for a great portrait for a family Christmas Card, at the end of the session we can leave time to take the "traditional" look and smile family photo.
Cute ideas are matching outfits (either casual or Sunday best dressed up depending on your family's style) or pajamas.
We really don't want an experience...just the traditional sit and smile with Santa portrait.

snippets: How to Choose the Perfect Photography Style for Your Family - Kara Powell Photography Facebook Pinterest Instagram Youtube Family Photography

832-573-3731 Get Started Today November 4, 2025 How to Choose the Perfect Photography Style for Your Family If you’re anything like me, I bet you’ve got a wall in your house dedicated to family photos, right?
But have you ever wondered how to choose the right photographer and the right style to capture your family’s unique spirit even better?
Although photographers frequently use jargon like “Lifestyle” and “Portrait,” it can be hard to truly understand what types of images these terms will produce.
First up, let’s talk about the Classic Style also known as Portrait Photography .
Picture your grandma’s vintage photo hanging on the wall – that’s a perfect example of traditional portrait photography.
Generally this is the “holiday card photo.” You can clearly see everyone’s face and everyone is looking at the camera and smiling.
Below is a great example of one of my classic portraits.
This style is perfect if your family loves a more casual look to their photos.
Below is an example of one of my lifestyle portraits during an extended family session.
Here at Kara Powell Photography my sessions are typically a combination of classic portraits and lifestyle fun.
I like doing fun portraits like this every once in a while.
Now, here’s the fun part: deciding on the best style for your family!
This isn’t about choosing ‘the best’ style out there, but rather what’s best for your family (and this might change depending on the season of life your family is in).
If your family is a lively bunch that’s constantly on the move, candid or lifestyle photography might work best.
For families that love tradition and formality, portrait photography could be the way to go.
For example, I generally include both “classic” and “candid” in my portrait sessions because my clients like a mix of both.
As you ponder over your next family photo session, let these styles play in your mind.
I can’t wait to see you and your family in front of my lens, capturing those moments that will become treasured memories!
I hope reading How to Choose the Perfect Photography Style for Your Family has given you some solid ideas!

snippets: After receiving her dog portraits, she reached out to us with bittersweet news: her beloved dog had passed away.
Despite the sadness she was feeling, she expressed how glad she was that she had a portrait of that tender moment, knowing it would forever symbolize the bond they shared.
At Jennifer Lindberg Portrait Studio, we understand our canine companions’ profound impact on our lives, especially as they enter their golden years.
That’s why we believe in preserving these precious moments through heartfelt portraits that serve as cherished keepsakes for years to come.
Each senior dog portrait session is an opportunity to celebrate the life and love shared between dog and owner.

From playful expressions to tender gazes, these black-and-white portraits beautifully encapsulate the spirit and vitality of our aging companions, reminding us of the joy they bring to our lives every day.

The Value of Senior Dog Portraits Preserving Memories Senior dog portraits hold immense value as cherished keepsakes, preserving the precious memories of shared moments and experiences between pet and owner.
These portraits become tangible reminders of the joy, love, and companionship senior dogs bring into our lives.
Senior dog portraits freeze these fleeting moments in time, allowing you to revisit and relive cherished memories for years to come.
Our goal in the portrait studio is to create a heartfelt tribute to the journey of your senior dog, celebrating the milestones, experiences, and memories they have made over the years.

From playful moments to quiet reflections, senior dog portraits capture the full spectrum of emotions and experiences, allowing you as pet owners to relive cherished memories and celebrate the bond you share with your loyal companions.
Honoring Relationships Senior dog portraits beautifully reflect the deep bond and connection between pet owners and their beloved companions.
Through the lens of a camera, the unique relationship and lifelong devotion shared between humans and their senior dogs are immortalized in timeless portraits.
These portraits serve as more than just images; they are visual representations of the profound bond and unconditional love that exist between you and your senior dogs.
Every glance, every touch, and every shared moment captured in these portraits speaks volumes about the special relationship that has developed over the years.
Creating Lasting Legacies These portraits hold a special place in the hearts of pet owners and become treasured family heirlooms, passed down through generations.
As time passes, these portraits become a link to the past, keeping the memory of senior dogs alive for children, grandchildren, and generations to come.
They tell beautiful stories, allowing family members to connect with the beloved pets who have touched their lives.
Senior dog portraits transcend time and generations, serving as a lasting tribute to the special bond shared between pet owners and their beloved companions.
They guarantee that the memory of senior dogs lives on, continuing to bring joy and comfort to future generations of families.
End of Life Dog Portraits Embracing Farewells As much as we celebrate the life and love of senior dogs, we also acknowledge the bittersweet reality of saying goodbye.
End-of-life portraits offer a sense of closure and comfort during the grieving process, allowing pet owners to cherish final moments with their beloved companions.
Senior dog portraits offer a sense of closure and comfort during the grieving process by providing a symbol and relic of the love and bond shared between pet and owner.
However, by capturing their essence in a portrait, we can create a lasting memento that honors the life and legacy of our furry friend.
Moreover, the act of creating these portraits allows pet owners to spend quality time with their senior dog, cherishing every moment and creating new memories to treasure.

We have been incredibly lucky to work with the same wonderful Santa for many years , and he has truly become a beloved part of our Christmas tradition at July Angel Photography.
Many families return year after year, and it is so sweet to watch their children grow while visiting the same familiar Santa each Christmas.
He takes the time to talk with them, listen to their Christmas wishes, share a laugh, and let each little personality shine.
Whether your child runs straight into Santa's arms or needs a little extra time to warm up, he is patient, gentle, and wonderful at making the experience feel natural and fun.
Over the years, we have captured everything from big hugs and belly laughs to quiet conversations, curious little looks, and even a few classic Santa tears.
For us, Santa Minis have never been about simply sitting beside Santa and smiling at the camera.
It's about capturing a little piece of childhood Christmas magic —the wonder, the excitement, and the memories your family will look back on years from now.
Take a look through some of our Santa memories from previous years below.

🎅✨ Santa Photos Ready in Time for Christmas Cards One reason we schedule our Santa Mini Sessions in October is to give families plenty of time to enjoy their photographs throughout the holiday season.

I love the idea that your Santa portraits can become more than social media photos — they can arrive in grandparents' mailboxes, hang on your walls, and become part of your family's Christmas memories for years to come.
Santa Photos as Home Decor / Wall Art Great family photos are more than just memories—they can also become a beautiful part of your home.
Whether displayed in a classic wood or gold frame for a warm, traditional look, or paired with a clean white mat and modern frame, these portraits can blend beautifully into your home decor.
They can become a special piece you look forward to bringing out every holiday season—and a sweet reminder of how much your family has grown from year to year.
For families and siblings, coordinate colors and textures rather than wearing identical outfits.
Santa Mini Sessions are approximately 10 minutes, which is usually plenty of time to capture a wonderful variety of portraits and interactions.
We keep the session moving naturally with conversations, hugs, sibling moments, wish lists, and family portraits while children are still engaged and excited.
Family interaction can also be especially helpful for younger children who may need a little extra reassurance when meeting Santa.
Can grandparents or extended family members join?
If you’d like to include grandparents, an Extended Family Add-On is available for $50 and up to two grandparents .
If cousins or multiple immediate families would like to participate together, please reserve consecutive sessions so we have enough time for everyone.
Can we take a family photo without Santa?
Because Santa Mini Sessions are specifically designed around the Santa experience, we typically do not set aside separate time for family portraits without Santa.
For babies who may cry or young children who are still unsure or afraid of Santa, I may photograph a few family portraits without Santa when appropriate.

If you have a specific request for family portraits without Santa , please let me know in advance by adding a note when booking, or mention it to me at the beginning of your session so I can plan our limited time accordingly.
For families looking for a larger variety of traditional holiday portraits without Santa, I recommend our separate Christmas Mini Sessions .

To help each family enjoy an uninterrupted Santa experience, we kindly ask arriving families to remain in the designated waiting area rather than entering the shooting area while another session is in progress.

Why I travelled from Frisco, TX to Dubai: My Dubai Photography Workshop Experience - Malka Ahmed Photography
snippets: Blog , Maternity , Newborn As a Frisco newborn photographer serving families across Frisco, Plano, and the greater Dallas–Fort Worth area , I’m always looking for ways to refine my craft and bring a luxury portrait experience to my clients.
While I’m known locally as a Dallas maternity photographer and baby photographer , I also believe that the best artists never stop learning.
Continuing education and creative inspiration are an important part of delivering beautiful, timeless imagery for the families I photograph.
Traveling across the world to learn from one of the most respected names in newborn and maternity photography was an experience I had dreamed about for years.
Golden hour maternity portrait captured in the desert outside Dubai during my international photography workshop.
Standing in the desert thousands of miles from home, camera in hand, photographing stunning maternity portraits felt surreal.
Ana has photographed countless newborns, celebrities, and families throughout her career, and her knowledge of the craft is extraordinary.

Throughout the workshop, we focused deeply on: ✨ Advanced posing techniques for newborns ✨ Creating flattering angles for maternity portraits ✨ Mastering lighting for soft, artistic imagery ✨ Efficient workflows during newborn sessions Even
Being in a room with talented photographers from around the world reminded me how far I’ve come while also inspiring me to continue evolving as a luxury maternity photographer and newborn artist.

The Magic of Photographing Maternity in the Dubai Desert While every part of the workshop was valuable, the highlight of the entire trip was the maternity photography portion held in the stunning desert landscape outside Dubai .
The endless sand dunes, the golden light, and the quiet stillness created the perfect backdrop for maternity portraits.
This portion of the workshop allowed me to fully step into my artistry as a luxury maternity photographer .
The techniques I refined during this workshop now influence every session I photograph, from newborn portraits to luxury maternity photography .
A luxury portrait experience inspired by world-class training My goal has always been to create artwork that families will treasure for generations.
It reminded me why I started this path in the first place — to create beautiful images, connect with families, and capture the fleeting moments that matter most.
My studio in Plano, TX is set up with everything I’ll need to photograph your family, and so that you can relax, enjoy the experience and make new memories.

Rio Grande Valley About Me I’m Carmen, the heart and artist behind Dolce Photography, a boutique photography studio in Mission, Texas, where timeless portraits and meaningful experiences are thoughtfully created for growing families.

For over 15 years, I’ve had the privilege of preserving life’s most beautiful chapters through newborn, maternity, and children’s photography, serving families across Mission, McAllen, Edinburg, and the Rio Grande Valley.
Dolce Photography was born from a deep love for family, motherhood, and the fleeting moments that pass far too quickly.
As a luxury newborn and maternity photographer in Mission TX, I believe your portraits should feel as exquisite as the love they represent.
From softly styled newborn sessions to elegant maternity portraits and childhood milestones, each image is carefully crafted to reflect emotion, connection, and timeless beauty.
I pour my heart into every session, treating each family’s story as something sacred and unique.

It is my greatest honor to serve families throughout Mission, McAllen, Edinburg, and surrounding South Texas communities, creating heirloom portraits that celebrate love, legacy, and the beauty of family.

meta: I travel through time with my camera to take cool chemical pictures. I use an old photographic process called wetplate collodion to create tintypes.
Ruby Bellows Tintype
About/Location — Ruby Bellows Tintype
snippets: 2018 About this little venture… View fullsize My own tintype portrait by Jonathan Grabill.
A stack of family post-mortem photographs dating from only-god-knows-when in the 1800s to the 1980s was seared into the back of my mind.
This fueled my desire to revive this method fully and bring it back into a society where filtered digital portrait photography has grown weary to me.
Tintype, also known as wet-plate collodion photography, is a timely and sensitive process that uses silver and collodion to capture a one-of-a-kind portrait that can't be physically duplicated.

Each image is produced on the spot by hand – pouring the collodion onto the plate, exposing, developing, and fixing the image - with the final result being a beautiful archival photograph that is family heirloom-worthy.

snippets: Senior Portraits Conroe Class of 2027
The story of how a teenager talked a Master Photographer into doing senior portraits all wrong, and somehow got everything right.
My senior portrait was supposed to be a coat-and-tie photograph against a neutral background.
And that is how I learned what senior portraits were actually for.

He started in photography in 1945 as a Coast Guard photographer and ran his studio in Greenville, Ohio, with the conviction of someone who had already photographed two generations of the same families.
I told him I would work for free in the studio for thirty days, and if no new clients came in asking for portraits like the pool photograph, the bet was his.
Five days later, eleven high school seniors had walked through his door asking for something that did not look like anyone else's senior portraits.
What I had learned, and what Ted had been too good a photographer to admit at first, was that the seniors did not want a portrait that looked like everyone else's portrait.
They wanted a portrait that looked like them.

Ted let me run weddings and family sittings with him, taught me how to work an eight-by-ten film camera, taught me how to light a face so that a person looked like the version of themselves they recognized in the mirror.
He also taught me, without ever using the words, that a portrait is a contract.
My own senior portrait by Ted is hanging in my home thirty-five years later.
What I do is the version of senior portraits I wish I had heard about as a parent, before I knew anything about photography.
The version where one photographer learns one senior, and then makes one body of work that the senior recognizes and the family will live with.
"The seniors did not want a portrait that looked like everyone else's portrait.
For years I ran a traditional studio, with a camera room, a reveal room, and a front door families walked through.
When I brought Swartz Portraits to Texas, I changed how the business works, on purpose.
Ninety-five percent of my families ask for location sessions.
It is the most useful hour I spend with a family.
I size and design each portrait for the exact place it will hang, at the size that room actually needs, and then I deliver it there myself and see it go up.
Between Ted's studio in Ohio and Swartz Portraits today, life took some interesting turns.

CONTACT US Corporate Headshots Tips & Tricks Are you about to have a professional portrait created for you?
Follow these simple tips & instructions to ensure your finished business head shot makes you look like a million bucks!
Deep Colors For a traditional, conservative business portrait which conveys success, we suggest deep colors such as black, navy blues and grays.
Remember, the darker the color, the more professional your finished portrait will look, not to mention the fact darker colors are more slimming.
Bright or busy jackets, shirts or blouses will distract the viewers eye from the face in a finished portrait.

Necklace For the women, should you want to wear a necklace or any jewelry, think about bringing multiple options and your photographer can give you his or her opinion as to what will work best for your portrait.
It will be plainly obvious if both your shirt and/or jacket do not fit in your finished portrait.
Manicured For men and women, if you plan on having a full-length portrait created, then your hands may appear in your finished portrait.
Belts For women wanting a full-length portrait, try to avoid wide belts.
Glasses If you wear glasses most of the time, then we recommend you wear them for your portrait.
However, we can light your portrait in ways which will attempt to avoid glass glare.
Get Some Rest Make sure you are well rested before your portrait session.

snippets: Denton Texas Santa Pictures - Children and Baby Portraits in Flower Mound MENU A Magical Visit with Santa The experience is unforgettable!
A Magical Visit with Santa at Brittanie Nicole Photography Can you imagine a place where the magic and wonder of Christmas with Santa come alive?
Where children are presented with the unique opportunity to visit with and interact with Santa in a relaxed environment for more than just a few moments?
What if, your child could spend private, one-on-one time with Santa without standing in line for hours at the malls in the Denton and Flower Mound/Lewisville areas just to get photos with Santa?

Now, you can provide them with that Santa experience without the hustle and bustle of the malls and flashing lights, all while receiving nostalgic, fine art, heirloom portraits of their one-of-a-kind visit with Santa!
Santa’s Story We are creating a storybook sequence of events to photograph for you.
The entire process is designed to create natural expressions and interactions between your child and Santa Claus.
The session takes place in Santa’s den where he will confirm their names on his nice list, ask them what they want for Christmas, show them the North Pole, and show them how his Magic toy bag works.
The fun with Santa continues with creating magic snow and helping to paint toys for other children.
Of course, Santa will share his cookies and milk, and then finish up with a reading of ‘Twas the Night Before Christmas.
Before they leave, they will help him decorate his Christmas tree and say goodbye.

snippets: HOW TO PREPARE WARDROBE The right clothing allows your face to dominate the portrait, all other elements in your photo should be secondary.
Big logos across your chest are not only distracting, they’re going to date your portraits.
Wrinkles WILL show up in your portraits.
Your senior portraits are only going to be as good as the combined effort of your photographer and you.
We discourage clients from wearing white shirts for most portraits, because white tends to draw the viewers eye, and detracts your eye from the face of the subject.
Don’t wear either for your senior portraits, it’s too trendy: it’ll make your fingernails look odd and they’ll look even stranger 20 years from now
Chapped or cracked lips are going to show in your portraits
JEWELRY It’s nice to include special or important jewelry in your portraits however keep in mind that too much jewelry can be distracting
Have a friend or family member come along to help fix hair and outfits.

A relaxed, guided family session Most families tell us they’re nervous about photos, especially with little ones.

Studio or outdoor sessions Family sessions are usually held outdoors, and smaller families can also choose our Kingwood studio.
Who can join your family photos Our sessions are built around your family, whatever it looks like.
Our Full Family Session covers up to 6 people, and more family members can be added for $25 each.

For most expecting mothers, maternity portraits are best scheduled when your belly is beautifully defined but you’re still comfortable enough to move and enjoy your session.

Every pregnancy is different, so we can adjust that timing based on what is best for you.

CLICK HERE to look at a branding session with Kristen Files Headshot photography and branding photography are two different types of photography that serve different purposes.
Headshot photography is a type of portrait photography that focuses on capturing a person's face and head, and is often used for professional purposes such as acting, modeling, or business.
Headshots are typically taken in a studio or other controlled setting and are used to represent the person's professional image.
The main difference between headshot photography and branding photography is their purpose.

Personal Branding: Your headshot is crucial to your personal brand.

Building Trust and Credibility: A high-quality headshot conveys trustworthiness and credibility.
Career Advancement: A professional headshot can significantly impact career advancement opportunities.

Consistency and Recognition: Using a consistent and professional headshot across various platforms helps with recognition and brand consistency.
Whether on your website, social media profiles, or business cards, having a recognizable headshot allows people to identify and remember you easily.
Flexibility and Versatility: A professional headshot can cater to different needs in various contexts.
The versatility of a well-crafted headshot ensures that you have a valuable asset to support your professional endeavors in multiple ways.
In conclusion, a professional headshot captured by a skilled photographer invests in your brand, reputation, and professional success.
With its versatility and impact, a professional headshot is essential for career advancement in today's visual-oriented professional landscape.

Photography isn’t just what we do; it’s how we serve families, celebrate milestones, and preserve the moments that matter most.

We’re the kind of family that sings Blink-182 way too loud in the car (yes… even when Zadie was five and knew every word), plans Disney trips like it’s an Olympic sport, and loads up the RV to explore Texas whenever we can.
Family is at the center of everything we do — and that belief carries into every session we photograph.
When you work with The Vails, you’re not just booking a photography session… you’re trusting a family who understands how important these moments truly are.

And then there’s Luxe — our beloved dog and four legged family member.
Everything we do is rooted in family, connection, and storytelling — because these moments don’t last forever, but the memories absolutely can.
We’re honored to serve our Devine community and beyond, and we can’t wait to welcome you into our studio, our story, and our Vail family.

by artist Heidi Knight Request a Private Consultation The families we love shape every chapter of our lives.
A commissioned family portrait preserves more than appearances.
It captures connection: the way you look at each other, the relationships that define your family, and the people who make your life what it is.
A family portrait does not have to feel formal or stuffy.
Created Exclusively for Your Family There is no other piece exactly like yours because there is no other family exactly like yours.
It becomes part of the home because it is part of the family.
Many families begin with one portrait and return for the next chapter.
A commissioned family portrait does exactly that.

snippets: Commissioned Portrait Artist in Texas
Begin Your Commission Commissioned portrait artwork for families who believe the people they love deserve a permanent place on their walls.
A Heidi Knight Original is a one-of-a-kind, hand-finished oil and acrylic mixed media portrait, created only for you and made to be lived with every day.
From a collector: “ Our engagement and bridal portraits stopped every guest at our wedding reception.
We’re collectors already!” "I never thought I would invest in a commissioned portrait, but from the first conversation, Heidi made the whole thing feel completely natural.
Each commissioned portrait is created as a mixed-media work on archival canvas and hand-finished in oils and acrylics.
The result is not simply a portrait of someone you love.
The portrait decides Not every portrait should be the same size.
The size of a Heidi Knight Original is chosen for the portrait itself, rather than simply to fill a particular wall.

The scale a commission can reach Originals may begin with an intimate portrait and extend to statement-scale artwork spanning 60, 80, or even 100 inches, including multi-panel commissions and select pieces created on Italian leather.

Each is a significant commission, and each receives the time that a work of art deserves" Begin Your Commission The Artist Long before I created Originals for clients, I created artwork of my own family for our home.
That desire for my own family became the foundation of the work I create today.
Most of the families I work with come back for a second piece, and then a third.

snippets: Menu BY DANA RUNDLOF Get In Touch with snow pixie photography The Difference Between Lifestyle Newborn Sessions and Studio Newborn Sessions June 5, 2024 Studio Newborn Sessions If you are looking for a newborn session for your baby, you mig
A studio newborn session takes place in a photographer’s studio — in my case, my home studio on my first floor — and includes beautiful, artistic images of your baby and family.
My lifestyle newborn sessions focus on your family, in your space, and capture the sweetness — and sometimes chaos —of bringing a new life home!
The sessions are relaxed, natural, and beautiful, capturing your family as you are.
I might photograph you rocking baby in baby’s nursery, your family cuddling on the couch, or baby sleeping in their crib.
Your final gallery will include everything from quiet moments of snuggling baby to the excitement of older siblings, and even family pets are welcome to join in the fun!

If you want a more casual, candid session incorporating elements of your home and lots of family images focusing on baby snuggles, then a lifestyle session in your home could be the right session for you.
Posing Ideas for Your Maternity Session June 28, 2023 Expecting and planning your maternity photoshoot?
It’s important to choose a photographer that is experienced doing maternity photography.
Maternity sessions can be light and airy, moody, ethereal, or fun and casual.
In terms of maternity posing ideas during the maternity shoot, keeping it natural, fun and relaxed are my recommendations.
Maternity photo shoots are all about the belly!
I do always like to get a bunch of gorgeous portraits just of the pregnant mama-to-be.
I capture your family together, including any visiting grandparents or siblings.

WHAT TO WEAR FOR YOUR PHOTOSESSION - RICHARD HILL STUDIO
snippets: North Texas Family Portrait Photography WHAT TO WEAR FOR YOUR PHOTOSESSION If there is one question we get asked more than any other at Richard Hill Studio, it’s this one.
Suddenly the whole family looks beautifully put together without looking like you all got dressed in the same shop.
WHILST WE LOVE A PAIR OF JEANS AND A COMFY HOODY AS MUCH AS THE NEXT PERSON, THERE IS NOTHING NICER THAN GETTING ALL FANCY FOR YOUR FAMILY PHOTOSESSION.
CO-ORDINATE, DON’T MATCH Matching outfits, everyone in the same colour, the same style, the same everything, can look a little flat in portraits.
LEAVE THE LOGO AT HOME We love a good brand as much as the next person, but your session portraits really aren’t the place for them.

Small, dense prints and bold all-over designs can look visually chaotic in portraits, create a distracting background noise in the image, and sometimes cause a flickering effect in photography that no amount of editing can fully fix.
The goal is for every eye that lands on your portrait to go straight to your family, not spend thirty seconds reading someone’s chest.
Your portraits will be all the better for it.
Accessories, shoes, and the finer details of an outfit can really elevate a portrait, or quietly let it down.
Soft fabrics, comfortable fits, and shoes they can actually move in will make a huge difference to how everyone feels on the day and how everyone looks in the portraits.
BRING A CHANGE OF OUTFIT If you’d like a little variety in your portrait collection, bringing a change of outfit for some or all of the family is a great idea.
It doesn’t need to be a full wardrobe change, even swapping a top layer or changing the kids into something more casual for a second look can give your portrait collection a lovely range of feels.
Children who have had some say in what they’re wearing tend to feel more confident and comfortable during the session and that absolutely comes through in the portraits.
We’re always happy to look at outfit photos, give honest feedback, and help you pull everything together in a way that feels right for your family and your home.

snippets: As a portrait artist, I am excited to be able to create timeless family heirlooms to live on the walls of your home and showcase the most important people in your life.
These portraits are your ticket to a time otherwise gone, and they will become some of your most treasured possessions.

This self-portrait above is truly one of the most valued images I have of my children because it can instantly take me back in time, and I can hear those sweet little giggles and feel the joy from this moment in time.
The older my children get, the more I treasure this portrait.
That's when I first started getting requests to use my photo skills to photograph other families.
Before long, I was getting calls from people I didn't know who wanted me to photograph their family, too.
I have been blessed to be able to live in many beautiful places and serve families from coast to coast before moving back to my hometown of Henderson, Texas.
Having a portrait studio in my hometown has been a dream of mine for so many years, and in 2019 I was able to see that dream come to life.
I have a small bright and airy camera room, a cozy area to view and select your favorite portraits, and a dressing room featuring a new makeup bar.

Growing up on a farm in a big family, animals were simply part of everyday life...
As a child, I loved visiting my grandparents in Arkansas, spending hours studying old family photos and searching for that thread of connection to generations past.
With few photos of my own childhood, I made a promise early on: to make sure my own family’s story would be beautifully documented.

Through my camera, I create heirloom artwork that captures the spirit and soul of families, pets, horses, and livestock, transforming everyday moments into timeless pieces of art that bring warmth and wonder to your home.

The most commonly preferred time to get your Maternity studio session is in the last 4-6 weeks of your pregnancy to get the fullest belly possible.

Flexibility and Versatility: A professional headshot can cater to different needs in various contexts.
The versatility of a well-crafted headshot ensures that you have a valuable asset to support your professional endeavors in multiple ways.
In conclusion, a professional headshot captured by a skilled photographer invests in your brand, reputation, and professional success.

We recommend reserving your maternity portrait session during pregnancy rather than waiting until the final weeks.

Your ideal timing may vary depending on whether this is your first pregnancy, whether you are expecting multiples and how you are feeling physically.
For most clients, we recommend scheduling maternity portraits between approximately 30 to 34 weeks.

snippets: Outside of weddings, I continue to work in a documentary and observational way through personal projects, including street photography, still life, and long-form visual studies.

Each year, I photograph around 20–25 weddings across Texas, the U.S., and beyond.

headings: Beyond the Headshot: 5 Types of Visual Content Every Law Firm Should Have

snippets: Beyond the Headshot: 5 Types of Visual Content Every Law Firm Should Have - Gittings Global Gittings Navigation Perspectives Beyond the Headshot: 5 Types of Visual Content Every Law Firm Should Have 14 September 2026 A professional headshot
But in today’s digital landscape, a headshot alone isn’t enough to tell your firm’s story.
Professional Headshots Let’s start with the essential.
Attorney headshots appear everywhere: firm websites, attorney bios, LinkedIn profiles, press releases, speaking engagements, legal directories, and event materials.
Professional headshots help establish consistency across your attorney roster and create a polished, cohesive look for your firm.
Depending on your firm’s brand, headshots can range from traditional studio portraits to more modern environmental portraits taken within the firm’s offices.
Marketing takeaway: Establish headshot guidelines so new attorneys can be photographed in a way that fits seamlessly with the rest of your firm’s visual identity.
Environmental Portraits Sometimes, the best way to show an attorney is to show them in their environment.
Environmental portraits place attorneys in their offices, conference rooms, libraries, courthouses, or other settings that reflect their work and personality.
For example, instead of using the same headshot every time an attorney is featured in a LinkedIn post, an environmental portrait can provide a fresh visual while maintaining a professional look.
Marketing takeaway: Build a library of images that gives your team options beyond the standard headshot.

A well-rounded library might include: Professional attorney headshots Environmental portraits Office and team photography Attorney interviews Short-form video clips Event photography Event video Behind-the-scenes content Recruiting and cult
The Bottom Line A headshot may introduce an attorney, but a broader visual strategy can tell a much bigger story.
